h: The Third Meal Reveals Divine Favor Beyond Reason

p: in which is the Will of wills," etc.
Now at night, at the first meal,
and in the morning, at the second meal,
we say, "May His light rest upon it," etc.,
"in which is the Will of wills."
at night there comes to each person
and in the morning the joy comes
from the light that enters the heart,
as it says, "The light of the righteous rejoices";
then the joy is "in which is the Will of wills"
out of simple will, without reason.
For at night the joy is
"They shall rejoice in Your Kingship, those who keep Shabbos," etc.,
And in the morning the joy is from the light;
"They shall be satisfied and delight in Your goodness"
which is from the light "that it was good";
and in this there is satiety,
And here the joy is from the will;
"And with the seventh You were pleased, and You sanctified it."
And likewise we say in the prayer:
for the holiness is in keeping Shabbos in deed;
"and grant our portion in Your Torah"
as it says, "and Torah is light";
in the passage "Let there be light"
כְּנֶגֶד ה׳ חוּמְשֵׁי תוֹרָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה ג, ה)
correspond to the five Chumshei Torah (Bereishis Rabbah 3:5);
and we say, "Satisfy us from Your goodness,"
from the light "that it was good."
And this corresponds to the morning meal,
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and it corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
and then there is satiety in the light, as stated.
"And gladden our soul with Your salvation"
this corresponds to the third meal,
when the joy comes from will without reason.
for the salvation of Yisrael is,
כִּבְיָכוֹל יְשׁוּעָתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
as it were, the salvation of HaKadosh Baruch Hu;
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and it corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ פָּרָשָׁה ב)
And as written (Midrash Rabbah, this parsha, Bamidbar Rabbah 2:2):
as it were, as if He were redeemed;
'and in the Name of our God we will raise our banners':
He is distinguished in His myriad," etc.
as we said from what is written,
שֶׁאֵין מַלְאָךְ אֶחָד עוֹשֶׂה ב׳ שְׁלִיחוּת
that no one angel performs two missions.
And so the holiness of the tribes:
that in each tribe there is a particular holiness;
and this is why He made them into banners,
so that they would be recognizable,
יְשַׂגֶּבְךָ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב (תְּהִלִּים כ, ב)
"May the Name of the God of Yaakov make you strong" (Tehillim 20:2).
"May He send your help from the Sanctuary" (Tehillim 20:3)
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קכא, א)
as written in the holy Zohar (II 121a):
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג פא, א)
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (III 81a):
is a holiness that rises above all holinesses,
and the holiness of Chochmah," etc.;
אָמַר לֵיהּ לָאו אוֹרַיְיתָא בְּלָא חָכְמְתָא
he said to him: "There is no Torah without Chochmah
and it is all on one level," etc.
That is, the Torah is yirah,
as written in the holy Zohar above,
for it is written, "The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem,"
וּכְתִיב הֵן יִרְאַת ה׳ הִיא חָכְמָה (אִיּוֹב כח, כח)
and it is written, "Behold, the fear of Hashem is wisdom" (Iyov 28:28).
And this is "and from Tziyon may He support you":
and this is the aspect of the hosts of the Mishkan,
And afterward it says, "Let us sing at Your salvation,"
which is from the simple will without reason,
and the salvation of Yisrael is,
כִּבְיָכוֹל יְשׁוּעָתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
as it were, the salvation of HaKadosh Baruch Hu;
and this is the holiness of this meal, as stated.
And likewise in the berachah of Krias Shema,
which is the berachah over the Torah,
which they merited out of abundant love
we say, "Enlighten our eyes in Your Torah,
to love and to fear Your Name":
this corresponds to the holiness of Avraham and Yitzchak,
which is the holiness of the first two meals:
"Satisfy us from Your goodness," as mentioned above.
כִּי בְשֵׁם קׇדְשְׁךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא בָּטָחְנוּ
"For in Your great and awesome holy Name we have trusted;
let us exult and rejoice in Your salvation":
שֶׁהוּא כְּנֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
this corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
And Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him, said,
"The God who has shepherded me from my beginning" etc.;
And this is "Let us sing at Your salvation"
כִּבְיָכוֹל יְשׁוּעָתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
as it were, the salvation of HaKadosh Baruch Hu.
And likewise, corresponding to this meal, we say,
"You called it the most desirable of days,"
is based on what is written
וְהַיְינוּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (פָּרָשָׁה ט)
And this is as written in Bereishis Rabbah (9:4):
הַלְוַאי תְּהֵא מַעֲלַת חֵן לְפָנַי בְּכָל עֵת
if only you would find favor before Me at all times
כְּשֵׁם שֶׁהֶעֱלֵית חֵן לְפָנַי בְּשָׁעָה זוֹ
as you have found favor before Me at this hour."
And just as there found favor before Him
so He desired the coming weekdays.
And this is the middah of Yaakov:
שְׂפַת אֱמֶת תִּכּוֹן לָעַד (מִשְׁלֵי יב, יט)
"The lip of truth shall be established forever" (Mishlei 12:19).
And as we say in the Minchah prayer:
וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי לְךָ ה׳ עֵת רָצוֹן (תְּהִלִּים סט, יד)
"And as for me, my prayer is to You, Hashem, at a time of favor" (Tehillim 69:14)
"answer me with the truth of Your salvation"
that the salvation be in the way of truth,
And for this we ask in the middle berachah,
"And purify our heart to serve You in truth"
that "the lip of truth shall be established forever."
